phase_prompt.label: Phase 2: The Validated
phase_prompt.summary: Identical to Phase 1, but with a focus on their internal validation. They hold the 'keys' to the next layer.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: Extreme close-up (ECU) of a single member of The Elect. Focus is on the eyes and the texture of the skin. The lighting is dramatic, cutting across the face to reveal micro-expressions of hope and endurance. In their hand, slightly out of focus in the foreground, they clutch a small object made of black obsidian or data-glass—an authentication token. The background is dark, suggesting the 'shadow of death,' but the subject's face is bathed in a soft, promise-filled fill light. Hyper-realistic details, wet eyes, pores, tangible atmosphere.
